notes:
Fixes being stuck on the loading screen after joining a match.

You could join a match but never get past the loading screen, while the match carried on behind it. The cause was in the match server: it was setting up your hotbar the way older versions of the game do, which this version of the game does not support, so your game never finished building your hotbar and never dropped the loading screen. It now uses the method this version expects.

This release also includes everything from 1.9.5 (faster matches, no ghost player, smoother updates). It has been built and tested, but not yet played through a match. If you still get stuck on the loading screen, send the log from the Logs tab.
